rows.grounds: compound phrase naming the superior fragment form
compound phrase describing height joined with a pillar

items.question: What is to be known as the fragment-superior form endowed with pillar height?
premises: Fragment-superior form is to be known.
It is endowed with pillar height.
items.inference: The verse designates the fragment-superior configuration as pillar-height-endowed.
uncertainties: Exact architectural referent of khaṇḍottara remains context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Thus the fragment-superior form is to be known as endowed with the height of a pillar.
